Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.scheduler

Class NewsletterGenerationScheduler

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.scheduler.NewsletterGenerationScheduler
@Component public class NewsletterGenerationScheduler extends Object
Scheduled job that generates a daily newsletter draft from the previous day's harvested articles.

Runs on the cron schedule defined by aihealthcare.newsletter.schedule in application.yml (default: daily at midnight UTC). On each tick the scheduler performs ingest, generation, and auto-delivery:

  1. Calls IngestArticlesUseCase.ingest(java.lang.String, java.time.LocalDate, java.util.List<java.lang.String>, int) to load the previous day's persisted articles from the database into the service session.
  2. Calls GenerateNewsletterUseCase.generate(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.NewsletterTone, int, boolean, int) to summarize the articles and persist a NewsletterRun in DRAFT status.
  3. Checks the auto-send override via NewsletterAutoSendPort — if overridden for today, the draft is left for manual review.
  4. Otherwise, calls DeliverNewsletterUseCase.deliver(java.lang.String) to send the newsletter to all active subscribers.

The "Override Auto Send Today" checkbox on the Newsletter Runs page (/newsletter/runs) lets admins suppress auto-send for a specific day. Manual send via the edit page resets the override.

The class depends only on inbound-port interfaces so the application's hexagonal boundary is preserved — it drives the domain but knows nothing of repositories, SMTP, or feed adapters.

Runtime identifiers (runId, draftId) are derived from Instant.now().toEpochMilli(). No external ID generator is required.

If any step throws, the exception is caught and logged at ERROR so the scheduler thread survives and the next scheduled tick can still run.

    • runDailyDraftGeneration

      @Scheduled(cron="${aihealthcare.newsletter.schedule}") public void runDailyDraftGeneration()
      Daily tick — runs the ingest → generate → deliver pipeline.

      Invoked by Spring on the schedule configured by aihealthcare.newsletter.schedule. After generating the draft, checks the auto-send override: if overridden for today, the draft is left for manual review; otherwise it is auto-sent to all subscribers. Failures at any stage are logged and swallowed so the scheduler thread remains alive for the next scheduled run.
